results.title: Attention Mechanisms in Transformers: A General Survey
results.snippet: This paper presents a comprehensive survey of attention mechanisms in Transformer architectures, emphasizing their evolution, design variants, and domain-specific applications in NLP, computer vision, and multimodal learning.

results.title: Attention Mechanism, Transformers, BERT, and GPT: Tutorial ...
results.snippet: This is a tutorial and survey paper on the attention mechanism, transformers, BERT, and GPT. We first explain attention mechanism, sequence-to-sequence model without and with attention, self-attention, and attention in different areas such as natural language processing and computer vision.

results.title: What is Attention Mechanism? A Comprehensive Survey of ...
results.snippet: Through this survey, we emphasized the pivotal role of attention-based models, especially those built on the Transformer architecture, in shaping diverse application domains such as natural language processing, computer vision, recommender systems, and sensor data analysis.

results.title: What is Attention Mechanism? A Comprehensive Survey of ...
results.snippet: This survey covers attention mechanisms and Transformer models published between 2014 and 2025, tracing the evolution from the foundational additive attention (Bahdanau et al., 2014) to recent advances such as Flash Attention 3 and LLaMA-based architectures.
